content.title: AIPAC PAC - About
content.text: | Our Mission We support pro-Israel Democratic and Republican members of Congress and congressional candidates to secure the future of the U.S.-Israel relationship. | Why We ExistThe AIPAC Political Action Committee is a political tool to further demonstrate the pro-Israel community’s support for pro-Israel members of Congress and candidates. Bipartisan support for the U.S.-Israel relationship is essential to ensure Israel’s long-term safety and security—and our PAC reflects that core value. | We stand with those who stand with Israel. We base our support only on a candidate’s support for the U.S.-Israel relationship.As America’s largest bipartisan pro-Israel PAC, we are proud to support pro-Israel Democrats and Republicans, and to define over the course of an election cycle who in Washington is a true friend of the Jewish state.The AIPAC Political PortalMillions of dollars are contributed by pro-Israel Americans to candidates for office, yet candidates don’t see the full impact or capabilities of our national grassroots political movement.The AIPAC Political Portal addresses this by transparently tying contributions to candidates’ support for our ally Israel by labeling it as pro-Israel support through the AIPAC PAC. | Who contributes to the PAC?The PAC is funded by thousands of AIPAC members across the country.AIPAC’s MissionThe mission of AIPAC is to encourage and persuade the U.S. government to enact specific policies that create a strong, enduring and mutually beneficial relationship with our ally Israel.
